parameters.query: SELECT t.id as tenant_id, t.slug as tenant_slug, t.name as tenant_name, wt.bot_name, wt.tone, s.name as service_name, s.price, s.duration FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN wa_tenant_config wt ON wt.tenant_slug = t.slug LEFT JOIN services s ON s.tenant_id = t.id AND s.active = true WHERE t.slug = '{{ $json.tenantSlug }}' LIMIT 20
